caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical candle holder rendered in shades of grey pencil on a light beige background. The object stands on a circular, scalloped-edged base supported by three legs. From the base, a vertical rod extends upward, serving as the central axis. Attached to this rod is a curved and decorative bracket, featuring symmetrical curls that support a candle holder at the top. This candle holder consists of a cylindrical support with a flared rim and rests on a drip tray with a ruffled edge. Additional structural elements include a hoop and a horizontal support connecting the rod to the base, as well as an arm that curves outward for extra stability. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular outline, and at the bottom, there are handwritten notes indicating the scale “1/4” = 1” and the name “G. Bernhardt.”
title: Candle Holder
